description: Write a simple TCP client-server program using sockets: the server echoes back whatever the client sends.
Write a program that generates a bar chart of monthly sales figures using matplotlib and saves it to a PNG file.
Write a program that reads a CSV of student names and scores using pandas, and prints the average score per student.
Write a program that uses lambda functions to filter a list of numbers for even values and sort a list of dictionaries by a given key.
Write a program that builds a simple knowledge graph of people and their relationships using networkx, adds a few people and relationships, and prints all relationships for a given person.
Write a program that reads a CSV of monthly sales data using pandas, computes the total per month, and generates a matplotlib bar chart of the totals, saved to a PNG file.
Write a Python program that sends a prompt to a local Ollama model using the ollama library and prints the response.
Write a Python program using langchain that connects to a local Ollama model and answers a simple question.

Write a program that uses a local LLM with tool-calling to answer questions using three tools: getting the current date/time, performing a web search, and querying a MySQL database. Demonstrate the agent using at least one of each tool.
